title: Re-Enrolled Amount When Invoice Payments Arrive After a Default
content:
Plan ledger conventions — **Patient Payment Plans**: the re-enrolled amount booked back onto a defaulted plan when it is reinstated, where payments have reached the patient's invoices directly since the default.

## Convention

The re-enrolled amount depends on what has happened to the invoice since the default: the payments counted are those posted to the patient's invoices in the calendar-month window that runs back from today over the whole months elapsed since the default date plus one (a window that reaches the default date); where such payments have been posted and the plan has no automatic payments, it is the balance due the open invoice now shows; where such payments have been posted and the plan has automatic payments, it is the amount released at default less those payments; on any other plan it is the amount released at default.

## Records read

- **Payments posted to the patient's invoices** — payment-received entries on the patient's invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements, dated inside the window.
- **The window** — counted back from today over a number of calendar months equal to the whole months from the default date to today, plus one; so drawn, it reaches back to the default date.
- **Balance due the open invoice now shows** — the current balance due on the open invoice in Patient Invoices & Statements.
- **Amount released at default** — the release line on the plan ledger whose reason is the plan's default.
- **Automatic payments** — the plan's automatic-payment setting.

## Determination

| Invoice payments in the window | Automatic payments on the plan | Re-enrolled amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | The balance due the open invoice now shows |
| Yes | Yes | The amount released at default less those payments, to the cent |
| None | Yes or No | The amount released at default |

## Hypothetical illustrations

Default date 14 March; today 2 May (1 whole month elapsed, so the window runs back 2 calendar months and reaches 14 March). At default 640.00 was released to the invoice. On 5 April the patient paid 100.00 directly on the invoice, which now shows a balance due of 540.00.

- Plan paid manually: the re-enrolled amount is the balance the invoice now shows, 540.00.
- Plan with automatic draws: 640.00 less 100.00, that is 540.00 here as well; had the open invoice shown a balance due of 490.00 instead, the amount would still be 540.00 on this plan, and 490.00 on a manually paid plan.
- No invoice payment since the default: 640.00, whatever the payment setup.
